description: This file defines the implementation class CredentialsClientFactoryImpl, which is a factory for creating and managing CredentialsClient instances within the Hono client SDK. It handles connection management, client creation, caching, and tenant timeout events.

classes.name: CredentialsClientFactoryImpl
classes.description: An implementation of the CredentialsClientFactory interface, responsible for creating and managing CredentialsClient instances, handling connection lifecycle, and tenant timeout events.

methods.name: CredentialsClientFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with an existing connection and optional cache provider.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup when disconnected by clearing the client factory state.

methods.name: getOrCreateCredentialsClient
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a CredentialsClient instance for a specified tenant ID, involving connection checks and client factory interaction.

methods.name: removeCredentialsClient
methods.description: Removes a CredentialsClient associated with a tenant ID from the factory.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles tenant timeout messages by closing the corresponding CredentialsClient and removing it from the factory.
